metadata.title: Product Streams
metadata.description: Outcome-based streams from connecting a back end to listing, pricing, order processing, fulfilment, steering and embedding marketplace connectivity in partner platforms.

streams.name: Connect a Commerce Back End to Marketplaces
streams.description: From signed contract to first live marketplace: choose the integration route (plugin, back-office connector, API or hub), bring product, price, stock and order data together and configure the marketplace setup with the onboarding team.
outcomes: Go live in weeks, not months
One integration instead of one per marketplace
Configuration that fits the merchant's processes
